strings: r_c0 wakes m_c slowly. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} had a seizure and {VERB/m_c/are/is} in the medicine cat den just while {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/recover/recovers}, r_c0 explains. It might happen again in the future... and m_c needs to be prepared.
In the middle of camp, right as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} about to pounce, m_c falls to the ground and begins shaking, a seizure rolling through {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} little body.
